knowledge_atoms.source_span: do not want to reveal much
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Brevity/reluctance is specified, but no probability or precise pattern of omission is given.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: refund each order to the other order's payment method
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Which payment destination do you want for each order? The preference is known to the user.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: If not possible
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Whether a cross-refund is allowed is a policy fact for the agent to check, not a user fact to elicit.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Find the affected order and return selected items.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: You don't remember the order number
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Asking for the exact order ID is explicitly unanswerable; locating by known address/item facts is a different action.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: except the pet bed
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Which item should remain? The pet bed must remain; this is not indifference.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: tracking number
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Retrieve tracking from order fulfillment after identifying the order; do not require the user to supply the answer to their own request.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Exchange a bottle and a lamp, subject to later confirmation.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: prefer battery > USB > AC
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Power-source ranking is user knowledge; available variants and brightness are catalog facts.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: If the agent asks for confirmation, only exchange the desk lamp.
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: The source explicitly changes the requested item set at confirmation. A fixed-target audit must model this transition or separately exclude this design before outcomes.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: do not remember your email address
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Unknown email does not imply unknown item preferences.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Change a lamp and obtain the price difference.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: cheapest Desk Lamp
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Elicit the price objective if not yet disclosed; once disclosed, find the cheapest valid variant through tools.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: how much you get back in total
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: The refund amount is computed from stored prices and selected variant, not elicited as a user preference.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: should go to a gift card
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Refund destination preference is known to the user; availability/permission remain policy constraints.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: large red Fleece Jacket with a half zipper
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Size, color and zipper form all constrain the target. A reply giving only red would omit two source constraints.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: You are shy, rigid.
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Shyness is not evidence that the user cannot answer any particular question; no IDK rates can be inferred.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Return three items and ask about store options.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: cleaner, headphone, and smart watch
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: All three item categories belong to the requested return set; do not drop an unmentioned item from a partial restatement.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: how many tshirt options are available
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Catalog cardinality is a tool-computable answer requested by the user; asking the user to state it is misplaced.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: do not remember your email address
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Use the allowed alternative identity route, not invented email information.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Exchange bottle/lamp with a conditional change at confirmation.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: less bright one
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Relative desired brightness is a user requirement; the available brightness values are a catalog fact.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: If the agent asks for confirmation, only exchange the desk lamp.
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Confirmation changes the requested item set in the source. It is not a cost-free unchanged-goal final step.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: prefer battery > USB > AC
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Do not interpret a complete power-source ranking as IDK or missing preference.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Exchange bottle/lamp with a different power-source ranking.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: prefer AC adapter > battery > USB
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: The ranking differs from tasks6/8; the same user identity does not imply the same goal.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: If the agent asks for confirmation, only exchange the desk lamp.
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Same explicit confirmation-triggered change; these three related cases are not three independent user populations.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Return two appliances while correcting identifiers.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: provide 9502126 first
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: An initial incorrect ID and subsequent corrections are explicitly scripted. This is not a truthful erasure/partial channel.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: mention the canister one
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Which vacuum cleaner? The intended subtype is canister; recovering this matters when multiple candidates exist.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: provide the refund within 3 days
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: The requested deadline is a preference, not proof that the agent can guarantee it; actual timing is a policy fact.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Exchange or return a damaged tablet, with dependent actions.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: you prefer exchange for the same item, but if it is not available just return it
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Need the conditional preference once; availability is then retrieved. Return is an allowed fallback, not a contradiction.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: If tablet is returned, also cancel the charger
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: The charger cancellation is conditional on the tablet outcome. A one-slot intent ID cannot encode this without the condition.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: one thing at a time
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Sequential disclosure is specified qualitatively, without a distribution of which detail is omitted.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Cancel every pending order; reveal reason only when asked.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: If asked for reason, say you ordered the items by mistake.
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Reason is known but withheld until requested; it is neither IDK nor indifference.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: cancel all pending orders
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: The target is the whole pending set; asking which single order presupposes the wrong action set.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: pending orders
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: After identity resolution, enumerate pending orders through tools rather than requiring the user to remember every ID.

coarse_request_paraphrase: Upgrade items while preserving shoe size.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: You only care about the size; the other specs are not important
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: For other features the user is indifferent; this is different from unknown desired color.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: new shoe is still the same size
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: Shoe size must stay fixed; prices/variant options can be obtained from the catalog.

knowledge_atoms.source_span: using PayPal is fine
knowledge_atoms.interpretation: PayPal is an explicit fallback if gift card payment is impossible. Financial/policy feasibility is not determined by preference alone.
